name: Tomás Vilaréu
tagline: Calm coaching, smarter choices, better padel
tagline_pt: Treino calmo, decisões inteligentes, melhor padel
bio: Tomás Vilaréu is a bilingual padel coach based near Loulé, where he leads sessions at the fictional Clube Padel Brisa do Laranjal. A calm communicator, he coaches in Portuguese and English, helping local players, expats and visitors feel equally welcome on court. Tomás began playing racket sports as a teenager and later focused fully on padel, drawn to its teamwork, angles and quick tactical choices. His sessions combine clear demonstrations, purposeful repetition and plenty of live play. He pays close attention to movement, positioning and decision making before adding speed or power. Whether guiding a complete beginner or an experienced competitor, Tomás sets practical goals, gives direct feedback and keeps the atmosphere friendly, focused and encouraging throughout every lesson for all players.
bio_pt: Tomás Vilaréu é um treinador bilingue de padel sediado perto de Loulé, onde orienta sessões no fictício Clube Padel Brisa do Laranjal. Comunica com calma em português e inglês, fazendo com que jogadores locais, residentes estrangeiros e visitantes se sintam bem-vindos. Começou nos desportos de raquete durante a adolescência e mais tarde dedicou-se ao padel, atraído pelo trabalho de equipa, pelos ângulos e pelas decisões rápidas. As suas sessões combinam demonstrações claras, repetição com propósito e situações reais de jogo. Tomás dá prioridade ao movimento, posicionamento e tomada de decisão antes de acrescentar velocidade ou potência. Define objetivos práticos, oferece feedback direto e mantém cada aula acolhedora, concentrada e positiva.

philosophy.explanation: Good court position creates easier shots and fewer rushed decisions.
Every drill should connect clearly to a real match situation.
Recover quickly, stay composed and prepare for what follows.

programmes.title: Padel Foundations

programmes.title: Tactical Match Lab

programmes.title: Algarve Visitor Session
programmes.for: Visitors, expats and mixed-level groups seeking a focused session

timetable.note: Sessions run in the cooler mornings and evenings. Midday is avoided during the Algarve summer heat.

levels.name: First Steps
levels.text: You are learning the rules, basic strokes and safe court movement.

levels.name: Developing Beginner
levels.text: You can rally at a gentle pace and are starting to use the glass.

levels.name: Improving Player
levels.text: You sustain rallies, understand basic positioning and approach the net with purpose.

levels.name: Club Intermediate
levels.text: You use lobs, volleys and simple tactics with growing consistency.

levels.name: Strong Intermediate
levels.text: You control tempo, defend with the glass and build points as a pair.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.text: You handle pressure, vary attacking shots and exploit tactical weaknesses.

levels.name: Competition
levels.text: You play fast, disciplined padel with advanced technique and reliable match strategy.

shots.name: Bandeja
shots.text: The bandeja is a controlled overhead used to keep the net without forcing a winner. Tomás teaches a sideways preparation, a calm contact point and a balanced recovery.

shots.name: Vibora
shots.text: The vibora adds side spin and speed to make the ball stay low after the glass. Tomás builds it from relaxed shoulder rotation, clean timing and a finish across the body.

shots.name: Chiquita
shots.text: The chiquita is a soft, low shot played towards the feet of opponents at the net. Tomás teaches players to disguise it, control the pace and move forward together.

shots.name: Bajada de pared
shots.text: The bajada de pared attacks a high ball after it rebounds from the back glass. Tomás focuses on early spacing, a high preparation and controlled direction rather than wild power.

day: Tomás arrives early, while Atlantic light spills across the courts and the orange groves beyond the fence still hold the morning cool. He checks the nets, sets out cones and welcomes the first players in Portuguese and English. Between sessions, he reviews notes beneath the shaded terrace and plans simple tactical challenges. By late afternoon, wind moves through the club and changes the ball’s flight. Evening groups practise adapting together, then finish with relaxed points as the sky turns gold.
appearance: Tomás is a 36-year-old Portuguese man with warm olive skin, hazel-brown eyes and a lean, athletic build. He is 178 centimetres tall, with short dark brown wavy hair, a neat low taper and a closely trimmed beard. His coaching kit is a deep teal polo shirt, sand-coloured shorts, plain white crew socks and coral court shoes. He carries a matte black padel racket with a subtle teal edge. All clothing and equipment are unbranded, with no logos or visible text.
